name: US open-front picking bin 7.375 x 4.125 x 3 in
description:
A US open-front picking bin, 7.375 x 4.125 x 3 in depth x width x height (187 x 105 x 76 mm), modelled on the Akro-Mils AkroBin 30220 from Akro-Mils sheet AKM505. The AkroBin part-number ladder is the de facto US reference for this family, and Quantum QUS and Uline sizes match it. The front wall stands at roughly 40% of the back wall's height with the side walls sweeping down between them on a curve, so an operator can reach in and pick without lifting the bin off the shelf.

External dimensions: depth 187 mm, width 105 mm, height 76 mm.

No formal standard; the Akro-Mils AkroBin part-number ladder is the de facto US reference, matched by Quantum QUS and Uline.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 1,876 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
